name: New Hampshire
dueDateNotes: Federal estimated payments are due April 15, June 15, September 15, and the following January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: New Hampshire does not tax personal income, so your quarterly estimates cover federal self-employment and income tax only.
uniqueFacts: New Hampshire does not tax earned or self-employment income, so 1099 income owes only federal quarterly taxes.
New Hampshire's old Interest & Dividends tax was fully repealed effective 2025, removing its last income-style tax.
